project_type: Single-file HTML/CSS/JS web application - interactive statistics testing platform
build_system: None - single file, no build step required
verification_instructions: 1. Verify index.html exists at /projects/sandbox/statistics/index.html. 2. Verify it contains valid HTML structure. 3. Verify JS classes and functions are present. 4. Verify no external dependencies are referenced.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - single HTML file that works offline
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode - no external CDNs, fonts, or libraries can be loaded. Everything must be self-contained in one file. No npm, no package managers needed.
contribution_requirements: Single file at /projects/sandbox/statistics/index.html containing all HTML, CSS, and JS
key_patterns: Greenfield project - establish patterns: modular JS with classes, CSS custom properties for theming, event-driven architecture, state management via class instances, localStorage for persistence
